ModuleTitle.helper: Used to sync with the system's module title. This does not display to site visitors. It makes it useful to restore and share content, if/when needed.
ModuleTitle.placeholder: Try entering anything that's somewhat unique

Products.helper: As you add more products, they'll begin to wrap into rows naturally, based on the content pane used, screen size, and number of products.

ProductName.helper: Enter the product name to use in this template. Use clear wording that visitors will understand.

ProductDescription.helper: Enter the formatted content for product description. Keep the text clear and easy to read.

MonthlyPrice.helper: If left blank, displays "Contact for Pricing" instead & the link is ignored.

MonthlyLink.helper: web addresses to where the checkout is found

YearlyPrice.helper: If left blank, displays "Contact for Pricing" instead & the link is ignored.

YearlyLink.helper: web addresses to where the checkout is found

HeaderImage.helper: Choose the image or file to use for header image. Use a clear file that fits this content.

IsFeatured.helper: Ideally, only one should be featured
